normalized.result: Yes, that's the right fallback. When the app couldn't pull the page's details, it didn't just throw my link away or block me — it kept the link, told me plainly what happened, and let me type in a title myself so I can still recognize it later. It wouldn't let me save until I'd given it a title, which makes sense to me since a nameless bookmark would be useless, and it left the description as optional. It also kept a "Try again" button in case the automatic fetch works on a second go. That's exactly how I'd want it to handle a page it can't read. This feels right.
